world.title: ASEAN, China committed to follow South China Sea declaration until code of conduct is completed
world.summary: ASEAN and China reaffirmed their commitment to the Declaration on the Conduct of Parties in the South China Sea until a code of conduct is finalized, according to Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. This statement was made during a meeting in Manila, emphasizing the importance of maintaining stability and cooperation in the region while awaiting the completion of the code.

world.title: A Washington boy who was autistic, nonverbal and legally blind died at 15 after years of abuse in his adoptive home; six years later, his estate and brothers secured a $49.33 million settlement
world.summary: Karreon Adams-Franks, a 15-year-old boy who was autistic, nonverbal, and legally blind, died in 2020 in Vancouver, Washington, after enduring years of abuse and starvation in his adoptive home. Six years later, his estate and two surviving brothers reached a settlement of $49.33 million, addressing the neglect and mistreatment he suffered during his life.

world.title: Donald Trump Debuts New Hairdo During Philippines ASEAN Visit, Internet Reacts
world.summary: During his visit to Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit, US President Donald Trump showcased a new hairstyle that appeared darker and more voluminous than his usual golden-blond look. This change prompted significant reactions on social media, with users commenting on the noticeable difference. Trump arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport on Tuesday, generating buzz online about his appearance.

business.title: After Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 employees, CEO Satya Nadella explains the decision; says: I wish I could just sit here and ...
business.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has discussed the company's decision to offer buyouts to 60,000 employees, clarifying that it is part of a broader effort to reshape team operations. He addressed concerns about potential AI-driven layoffs but emphasized that the initiative aims to enhance efficiency and adaptability within the organization, rather than indicating an impending workforce reduction due to AI.

business.title: India Gives Green Light to Commercial Sustainable Jet Fuel Production
business.summary: India has approved the commercial supply of sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) from Indian Oil Corporation’s Panipat refinery. This marks the first batch produced at the country’s first commercial-scale SAF plant. The approval aligns with India's target for blending sustainable fuel by 2027, supporting the aviation sector's transition to more environmentally friendly fuel sources.

business.title: 'Ulta Pradesh' to 'Uttam Pradesh': Yogi minister on UP's transformation under BJP government
business.summary: A Yogi minister highlighted Uttar Pradesh's transformation under the BJP government, stating the state has demonstrated progress across various sectors over the past nine to ten years. He noted that while it was previously referred to as "Ulta Pradesh," it is now recognized as "Uttam Pradesh." The minister emphasized the significant changes and improvements achieved during this period.

technology.title: Temple wearable voice detection recreated on laptop, earns Deepinder Goyal's praise
technology.summary: A tech enthusiast from Bengaluru successfully recreated the vibration-based voice detection technology from Temple's wearable device using a laptop accelerometer. This innovative experiment garnered the attention of Deepinder Goyal, the founder of Zomato, who praised the effort. In recognition of the achievement, Goyal offered the enthusiast a one-day trial of the Temple device for further exploration.

technology.title: GTA 6 Special Abilities for Jason and Lucia Explained
technology.summary: GTA 6 introduces character-specific special abilities for protagonists Jason and Lucia, enhancing gameplay with unique skills. These abilities provide players with distinct combat advantages, allowing for varied strategies during missions. The game emphasizes the importance of these skills in shaping player experiences, offering insights into how Jason and Lucia's talents can influence gameplay dynamics and overall performance in the game.

technology.title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Sold 1 Million Physical Copies In Its First Week, The Most Since Tears Of The Kingdom
technology.summary: The Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time sold 1 million physical copies in its first week in the U.S. This marks the highest sales for a physical game since the release of Tears of the Kingdom in 2023. The success highlights ongoing demand for physical copies among fans of the franchise.

sports.title: MS Dhoni: Former India captain retires from playing role with IPL's Chennai Super Kings aged 45
sports.summary: Former India captain MS Dhoni has announced his retirement from playing with the Chennai Super Kings in the Indian Premier League at age 45. Known as "Captain Cool," he led India to World Cup victories in both formats. Dhoni will transition to a mentorship role starting in the 2027 season, having previously retired from international cricket in 2020.

sports.title: Retained and Released Players
sports.summary: Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB), the defending champions, will announce their IPL 2027 retention list today. The announcement will include updates on players such as Josh Hazlewood and Jacob Bethell. RCB won its first IPL title in 2025 and successfully defended it in 2026, marking a significant achievement after 18 years of competition in the league.

sports.title: SGP v BRA Highlights; Brazil beat Singapore 7-0 in friendly at National stadium, Singapore; Vinicius and Endrick shine
sports.summary: Brazil defeated Singapore 7-0 in an international friendly match at the National Stadium in Singapore. The Brazilian team showcased a dominant performance, particularly in the first half, with standout contributions from players Vinicius and Endrick. The match highlighted the skill disparity between the teams, as Brazil utilized both experienced and younger players throughout the game.

health.title: India Records 38% Drop in TB Deaths Since 2015, Outpaces Global Decline: WHO
health.summary: India has achieved a 38% reduction in tuberculosis (TB) deaths since 2015, surpassing the global decline of 35%, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO) in its Global Tuberculosis Report 2026. This progress highlights India's intensified efforts in combating TB, contributing significantly to global health goals and showcasing the effectiveness of its public health strategies against the disease.

health.title: HPV Vaccine And Cervical Cancer: How Does The Vaccine Prevent Cervical Cancer? Age Guidelines, Side Effects And More
health.summary: The WHO recommends HPV vaccination for girls aged 9 to 14, with variations by country. The vaccine can also be administered to boys in certain regions, as HPV is linked to various cancers and can be transmitted. World Cervical Cancer Elimination Day, observed on November 17, aims to raise awareness and improve access to HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention.

science.title: Scientists discover 13-million-year-old vampire camel in America with fangs
science.summary: Scientists have discovered a 13-million-year-old camel species in North America, characterized by two sets of blade-shaped fangs. This long-legged camel, which inhabited the southern Great Plains, provides valuable insights into the evolution of camels. The findings contribute to the understanding of ancient fauna and the ecological dynamics of the region during that period.

science.title: Jupiter-Mars conjunction 2026: Best images here!
science.summary: In November 2026, Jupiter and Mars experienced a close conjunction, visible in the morning sky. The planets appeared to edge closer throughout the month, culminating in their closest alignment from November 15-17. A gallery showcasing stunning images captured by photographers worldwide highlights this celestial event, celebrating the beauty of the conjunction between the bright planet and the reddish one.

science.title: DESI weighs the Milky Way more precisely than ever
science.summary: Astronomers have improved the estimation of the Milky Way's mass by tracking the movements of stars and satellite galaxies influenced by its gravity. Faster movements indicate a greater mass is required to keep these objects stable. Current measurements reveal that much of the galaxy's mass remains unaccounted for, leading to significant variations in mass estimates.

entertainment.title: 'Big Disappointment': Shraddha Kapoor's Ji Ji Re Ji Song From Eetha Divides The Internet
entertainment.summary: The song "Ji Ji Re Ji," featuring Shraddha Kapoor, was released as the first track from her upcoming film Eetha. Sung by Shreya Ghoshal and composed by Ajay-Atul, the song has sparked mixed reactions online. While some viewers criticized Shraddha's performance and the composition, others expressed appreciation, leading to a divided response across social media platforms.

entertainment.title: OM and Godzilla Minus Zero Among Seven Films Set for November 19-20 Box Office Clash as Advance Bookings Begin
entertainment.summary: Seven films, including OM and Godzilla Minus Zero, are set to release in Indian theaters on November 19-20, leading to a competitive box office weekend. ENE Repeat currently leads in advance gross, while Bachelor Party D'eux shows strong ticket demand. The lineup features a mix of Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and international cinema, attracting significant audience interest.

entertainment.title: Ramayana Ranks Among IMDb's Top 3 Most Popular Movies Worldwide This Week, Only Indian Film in Global Top 10
entertainment.summary: Namit Malhotra's film Ramayana has achieved significant box office success, ranking third on IMDb's Most Popular Movies chart worldwide this week. This marks a notable accomplishment as it is the only Indian film to feature in the global top 10. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana continues to attract audiences and generate interest in the film industry.
